entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Bicesse Accords 1991; elections 1992 (MPLA wins, Savimbi rejects results); war resumes; Lusaka Protocol 1994; diamond-fueled UNITA insurgency; siege of Huambo and Kuito; Savimbi killed February 2002; ceasefire.
